title: Data visualization / Design — Basics

location.series: IBM Design Language / public web guidelines
location.extent: Complete webpage content-area capture; visible default tab states

slide_intent: Coordinate labels, color, interaction and transitions so viewers can understand a chart’s meaning before exploring its detail.
strategic_value: Purposeful IBM color and a consistent chart anatomy can connect recognition with usable, accurate analytical displays.
demonstration: The page pairs chart-anatomy and density comparisons with color-emphasis examples, a map, a patterned line chart, and captured interaction and motion demonstrations.
practical_value: Decide which information must be visible immediately, how to encode emphasis and quantity, and which details can appear through interaction.

content_islands.name: Resources and chart anatomy
content_islands.spec: Place the resource card above a chart specimen, concise-versus-long title comparison and grid-density comparison.

content_islands.name: Color and hierarchy
content_islands.spec: Continue with palette resources and charts using blue emphasis, gray context and quantitative color ranges.

content_islands.name: Texture and markers
content_islands.spec: Follow the map with a monochrome patterned line chart demonstrating non-color distinctions.

content_islands.name: Interaction
content_islands.spec: Place the overview-first rationale with its black video poster of a row of dots.

content_islands.name: Motion
content_islands.spec: End with paired green/red-labelled video posters illustrating the source’s contrast between clarifying changes and hiding connections.

reference_purposes.Intent: The color section explains recognition and meaning; interaction guidance explains exploration and understanding; motion guidance explains making changes unambiguous.
reference_purposes.Expression: Blue accents, gray context, patterned lines and consistent typography demonstrate IBM’s analytical visual treatment.
reference_purposes.Application: The page teaches concise insight-led titles, direct labels, appropriate grid density, purposeful color and details on demand.
reference_purposes.Constraint: Important information must not be hidden behind interactive behavior, and transitions must not communicate contradictory information.

ingredient.name: Chart color and non-color encoding
ingredient.role: Direct attention and encode relationships without losing readability.
ingredient.application: Give each color a purpose, use gray for context and reinforce meaning with shape, line or pattern; choose categorical or sequential palettes according to the relationship.
ingredient.scope: IBM data-visualization guidance. Palette selection is tied to data meaning and accessibility, not a universal decorative color ratio.
